rationale: User-reachable codes that DELIBERATELY route to the generic localized fallback instead of bespoke copy: internal faults, not-configured / not-implemented / not-wired states, and machine-to-machine webhook signature/IP rejections that never surface as actionable user copy. This is a SHRINK-ONLY ratchet: removing a code (by giving it real catalog copy) is allowed; adding a new one requires explicit review. The coverage gate asserts every emitted user-reachable code is EITHER in the catalog OR in this allowlist.
